no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Cronos Group is a Canadian-based consumer cannabis company (cultivation, branded cannabis flower/edibles brands such as Spinach, PEACE NATURALS, Lord Jones). It does not run prescription drug clinical trials and has no active P1/P2/P3 therapeutic candidates as of the latest 10-K (FY2025).
